main_measure.name: Excess forward 20-bar return of short bars over all bars (non-overlapping 20-bar blocks)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if excess < 0 with t <= -2 and the supporting slope is not positive; reject if excess > 0 with t >= +2; otherwise inconclusive; at least 6 short blocks (120 short bars)

supporting_check.name: Slope of forward 20-bar return on |forecast| within short blocks (should be <= 0)

decided_by: t lies between -2 and +2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Blocks are the bars at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with a full 20-bar forward return inside the window; a short block is one whose start bar has a negative forecast; the main measure is the Welch t of short-block returns minus all-block returns; the slope uses |forecast| on short blocks; the minimum is not reached if either fewer than 6 short blocks or fewer than 120 short bars.
